LanguageData.SSC_PnaMaintenance_Unavailable: PNA maintenance cannot be configured right now.
LanguageData.SSC_PnaMaintenance_Tooltip: After finishing the current task, consume raw PNA before taking another ordinary job until activation reaches the selected stage. Takes one unit at a time and only applies to a sex slave with a valid chain.\nThe first stage is replenished once activation disappears; a single dose may exceed the target stage. This setting belongs to the current chain and is lost when that chain is removed. Vanilla scheduled drug use remains independent.\nMaintenance also works while a caravan travels or stops during the day, and pauses during night rest. Uses personal raw PNA first, then shared caravan stock, including pack animals. Adds at most one dose per check after vanilla scheduled drug use, only if activation is still below the target.
